detect.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no package.json, this is not a JavaScript or TypeScript project" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
printf '%s\n' "$pm"

enabledShifts.fallback: list dependencies from the lockfile without advisory severity, reachability, or runtime exposure
report that no advisory source is available and record only dependency names from the lockfile

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or npm audit stops accepting the lockfile the recipe reads

permissionRequirements: fallback: npm audit output is advisory only; reachability is unknown when the registry cannot prove it; record runtime versus development exposure from the lockfile, never compliance or exploitability

probe.command:
if [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then exit 1; fi
npm audit --audit-level=none >/dev/null 2>&1

smoke.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm audit --audit-level=none --json
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm audit --audit-level=none
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn npm audit --audit-level=none
else
  echo "nightshift: no lockfile, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
